title: COBALT BEACON wiper attack damaged Eastgate Freight Authority operating insurance claim pipelines in Peru erasing 900 payment terminals (CVE-2020-9900524)
content:
COBALT BEACON wiper attack damaged Eastgate Freight Authority operating insurance claim pipelines in Peru erasing 900 payment terminals (CVE-2020-9900524)

COBALT BEACON wiper attack damaged Eastgate Freight Authority operating insurance claim pipelines in Peru erasing 900 payment terminals. First public reporting on this intrusion. Analysts linked the activity to the OPERATION HOLLOW REED 00129 cluster and flagged CVE-2020-9900524 as the initial access vector. Impact: 900 payment terminals at Eastgate Freight Authority.
